verdict.language_detail: MATLAB (gravity gradient tensor computation for vertical cylinder)
verdict.provenance_detail: Research code by Dailei Zhang, 2016, computing gravity gradient tensor components of a vertical cylinder using elliptic integrals and FFT-based component transformation
verdict.purpose: Computes all gravity gradient tensor components (Txx, Tyy, Txy, Txz, Tyz, Tzz) for a vertical cylinder model using elliptic integrals and 2D FFT-based transformation, with prism approximation for verification
